name: Charon Information Systems
summary: Melbourne unlimited dialup ISP (PO Box 12065 A'Beckett St; Clayton POP; charon.net.au), 15MB free web space; defunct. Trading name "Charon Information Services".

events.details: charon.net.au captured 5 Jan 1997 with Last modified 22 Dec 1996, ©1996; 33.6k modem upgrade announced 24 Dec 1996.

charon.net.au still served the live 'Welcome to Charon Internet' ISP homepage (dialup + web hosting + broadband) at the 13 Feb 2008 capture; the domain had become a 301 redirect by the next capture (Feb 2012), so retail ended c.2008-2011.

ACN 095 899 317 (CHARON SYSTEMS PTY LTD) was previously cited for this ISP but is likely a name collision: that company registered only 14 Feb 2001, is based at VIC 3228 (Surf Coast, not Melbourne), and remains active in 2026 whereas the Charon dialup ISP died 2005; its name ('Charon Systems') also differs from the ISP's 'Charon Information Systems/Services'. ACN removed from summary pending a positive link.
